title: AdRequestV1
description: Input contract for the engine's ad.post workflow. Distinct from brief.v1 (organic social) — ads carry aspect ratios, generation engine, layout mode, optional vault refs, asset ids, and an optional ad purpose. Closed schema (rejects extras) so the daemon can validate before spawning.

vault_refs.description: Template vault entry ids required for template-led layout mode. Ignored when layout_mode='strategy'.

asset_ids.description: Asset ids (uploaded product photos/logos) the agent may compose into the generation.
